subject: Post-call: HIPAA/BAA eligibility & PHI handling - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: HIPAA/BAA eligibility & PHI handling - next steps

Hi Alicia - great to meet today, thanks for carving out time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

Key points we heard (from HealthCloud):
- You need a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in place before HealthCloud sends PHI to any vendor.
- Primary deployment preference is Private (VPC or on-prem) for PHI-based workloads; Dedicated reserved capacity is also acceptable with isolated tenancy and contractual controls.
- You asked whether Redwood Hosted API can be covered by a BAA and what PHI boundaries would look like there.

What Redwood can offer (summary):
- BAA: Redwood offers a standard BAA and is willing to execute - attached is the initial draft (Redwood-BAA-Draft.pdf).
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated (reserved, single-tenant GPU pools) and Private (VPC / on-prem). Hosted (public multitenant API) is generally not recommended for PHI unless we agree to a bespoke architecture + controls; we can discuss options but our standard HIPAA support is centered on Dedicated/Private.
- PHI handling boundaries: Redwood can be configured to avoid persistent storage of PHI, enable customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments, and restrict logs/audit retention per your policy. We'll need to capture specifics in the vendor security questionnaire so our security team can provide exact configurations and attestations.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Please review the attached BAA draft and flag any edits. We can push this to DocuSign once you've indicated redlines.
2) HealthCloud to share the vendor security questionnaire (or we can start one on your behalf) - this will surface specific controls around data flows, keys, logging, and audit.
3) Redwood security (cc'd: Nikhil) to follow up on SOC 2 status, encryption & key management details within 48 business hours.
4) Tentative follow-up call: Thursday 6/8 or Friday 6/9 to go over the questionnaire and timing for BAA execution.

Attachments: Redwood-BAA-Draft.pdf, HIPAA-deployment-matrix.xlsx

If that looks right, I'll send the DocuSign links and draft answers to the questionnaire as a first pass.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

Thanks Marissa - this is perfect, appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We will need the executed BAA before any production PHI flows. We'll review the draft and get back with redlines by EOD Thursday.
- For now our security preference is Private first, Dedicated second. We only consider Hosted if you can provide contractual assurances + architecture changes and we validate them via the questionnaire.
- I attached our vendor security questionnaire (VSAQ-HealthCloud.pdf) to this reply - please confirm who on your team will own responses and an ETA.

Also: can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status and the date of the most recent audit report? That will help our InfoSec triage.

We'll aim to meet on 6/9 at 10am PT. Let me know if that still works for you.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: HIPAA/BAA eligibility & PHI handling - next steps

Hi Alicia - quick update after syncing with our security and infra leads:

Answers / clarification:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; our most recent assessment completed 2028-03-15. We'll share the auditor report under NDA - Dylan will coordinate the transfer.
- BAA: We can execute the attached BAA (see Redwood-BAA-Draft.pdf). Please send any redlines and we will route for legal review; once agreed we'll push to DocuSign.
- Eligible deployments for PHI: Dedicated and Private are fully supported for PHI. Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools with tenancy and contractual isolation. Private (VPC / on-prem) provides the strongest controls including customer-managed KMS and air-gapped options.
- Hosted API: not supported for PHI in standard multitenant mode. We can discuss a bespoke hosted arrangement but that will require architecture changes and contractual terms; not recommended for initial go-live.
- PHI handling: We can configure to avoid persistent storage of PHI and limit audit retention. For Private deployments we support CMK (customer-managed keys) and HSM integrations.

Next steps we propose:
1) HealthCloud to return reviewed BAA and redlines.
2) Dylan to share SOC 2 report via secure link and start the VSAQ intake (he's copied).
3) We will fill out the vendor questionnaire and return within 48 business hours; if any gaps appear we'll list mitigations.

Call: 6/9 at 10am PT still works for our team - we'll use that slot to walk the questionnaire and align on timelines for BAA execution.

Links: Vendor intake form (https://redwood.app/sales/deals/HC-2028-0423) | Shared drive with security artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodHIPAA

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.
